findings.status: resolved for owned C1 and transferred C2
findings.evidence: Candidate absolute watchdog owns registered channels and candidate authority; expiry closes channels, cancels processing, waits for joined processing before fallback. Final rename shares candidate/overall authority lock; file and directory fsync occur outside that authority lock. Production app displays disconnecting on expiry. candidateDeadlineClosesReverseChannelWhileBlockedCommitJoins passes against real loopback encrypted exchange with blocked commit dependency.

Listener processing task construction and publication occur under the stop lock. Registration observing an already stopped listener cancels task and closes socket before joining. A deterministic registration latch and blocked authenticated replay persistence test confirms peer EOF, delayed stop completion and cancellation observed by retained work.

limitations: Pre-transfer C2 is listener-owned. Listener stop cancellation/join is tested separately; candidate watchdog is not claimed to cancel arbitrary pre-transfer replay persistence.
Source and focused tests do not establish native UI, physical routing, cross-device runtime success or all RC-01 through RC-13 supplemental cases.
